prompts.name: 偏心沟谷与低位倒木
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original pixel-art background composition study for an underwater pond/lake-bottom side-view game, ROUND ONE TERRAIN AND LARGE FORMS ONLY.
Reference image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Extract its handcrafted pixel clusters, muted teal water depth, olive silt, weathered wood, asymmetrical natural banks and soft underwater shafts. Create a completely ORIGINAL layout, do not reproduce the reference or any existing game's scene.
Output one very wide landscape image, intended aspect ratio 8:3, ideally 1536 x 576. Fill frame; no borders, contact sheet, labels, text, logo or UI. Orthographic side view, not a top-down/isometric map, not realistic painting. Cohesive crisp pixel-art with clearly stepped edges and deliberate small pixel clusters; no blurry painterly brushwork or excessive grain/confetti.
Scope: ONLY terrain, water, light, fallen wood and stones. NO plants, grass, moss, floating leaves, hanging vines, fish, shrimp, snails, characters, food, hooks or lines. These are later stages. Bare weathered wood roots as part of a stump are allowed.
The main swimming/readability space is empty low-detail water: preserve an unbroken broad central band across x=25–78%, y=16–64%. Keep all major solid anchors below y=62% or at outer margins. Terrain occupies lowest 20–34% in the center, higher at edges. Terrain is visual background set dressing, so do not make a wall across the central play area. No evenly spaced humps, sinusoidal slopes, symmetrical U, neat stratified parallel contour lines or repeated same-size stones. Vary slope lengths, ledges, erosion, small local deposits and cluster sizes.
Depth: distant terrain recedes in low-saturation blue-teal, faint and dark; middle terrain muted olive/silt, nearest bottom edge darker with crisp selective highlights. 1–2 dominant large anchors, several subordinate rocks, avoid uniform clutter. Water surface is a very thin restrained top strip; broad gentle diagonal light shafts behind the action space, no bright isolated sparkles. A finished pixel-art art-direction study, but intentionally no ecology yet.
Distinct composition A: a natural off-center trough deepest at x=59%. Left bank slopes down gradually over a long irregular run from y=66% to y=87%; right bank has a shorter steeper shoulder rising to y=73% near the edge. One old fallen log traverses the LOW trough diagonally from x=15%, y=76% toward x=76%, y=87%, resting against rocks rather than floating. Its snapped end and single branch stub are the main anchor. A broad half-buried boulder at far right balances it, accompanied by three unequal smaller stones, not paired symmetrical boulders. Leave the entire central upper two thirds beautifully empty. Slight shallow sediment channel curls beneath the low log. Warm dull silt highlights, cool muted olive wood, luminous restrained teal water.
